entries.en: They’re all missing. Most are probably long dead. But as long as their photo is up here, there’s still hope.
entries.ro: Toți sunt dispăruți. Cei mai mulți sunt probabil morți de mult. Dar cât timp poza lor e aici, mai e speranță.

entries.en: So many of them, though... Wonder which one was the first.
entries.ro: Dar sunt atât de mulți... Mă întreb care a fost primul.

entries.en: There was this one boy from BARGHEST. When he’d disappeared, Hansen's people said the boy has deserted.
entries.ro: A fost un băiat din BARGHEST. Când a dispărut, oamenii lui Hansen au spus că a dezertat.

entries.en: His mother didn't believe them, though. She plastered his photos all over Dogtown, but someone kept taking them down.
entries.ro: Mama lui nu i-a crezut. A lipit pozele lui peste tot în Dogtown, dar cineva le tot dădea jos.

entries.en: In the end, only one photo remained. Here, on this tree. Could still be here after all these years.
entries.ro: La urmă a rămas o singură poză. Aici, pe copacul ăsta. Poate tot mai e aici după atâția ani.

entries.en: What about the soldier? Was he ever found?
entries.ro: Dar soldatul? A fost găsit vreodată?

entries.en: Of course not. And the mother disappeared soon after.
entries.ro: Sigur că nu. Și mama a dispărut la scurt timp după.
